title: Claim Listing
content:
Claim Listing

Are you the official representative of a company, supplier, distributor, laboratory, or service provider already listed on Aerogela? Use this page to request control of the existing listing instead of creating a duplicate entry.

Before you submit

  • Use a business email on your company domain whenever possible.
  • Add your company website and a proof link such as a team page, contact page, or profile page.
  • Explain your role and why you are authorized to manage the listing.

What happens next

  • Aerogela reviews your request manually.
  • Typical review time is 2–5 business days.
  • If approved, the listing can be marked as officially managed and linked to the representative account.
